title: Parts Purchase Orders page shows Vendor, Status, Date and Ordered by filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Parts area and go to the Purchase Orders page.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the purchase orders table.
expected: 1. The Purchase Orders page shows four filter buttons: Vendor, Status, Date and Ordered by.
2. The table shows the columns: Work Order, Purchase Order Number, Vendor, Order Status, Created On, Ordered By, Total Price and Note.
3. A blue New Purchase Order button is shown at the top right.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5 #6
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Option lists and apply behaviour pending Branko's PRD.
